standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the stalk of a summand of a finite free module over a local ring as free of a rank depending on the point.

standard_prerequisites.name: The criterion for a module of finite presentation whose stalk at a point is free to be free of that rank on a neighbourhood

standard_prerequisites.use: Spreads the local freeness of the stalk to an open neighbourhood of the point.

core_obligations: Trivialise the ambient module: at a point the proof uses that the finite locally free module containing the summand has a free stalk over the local ring (proof lines 2400-2404)
Identify the stalk of the summand: over a local ring a direct summand of a finite free module is again finite free of some rank, so the stalk of the summand is finite free (proof lines 2404-2406)

Spread to a neighbourhood: the summand is of finite presentation as a summand of a finite locally free module, so the criterion for a free stalk of a finitely presented module gives an open neighbourhood on which the summand is free of the same rank (proof lines 2407-2410)
proof_roadmap: 设 F 是有限局部自由模 H 的直和项。对 x ∈ X，H_x 是 O_{X,x} 上的有限自由模。
因 O_{X,x} 是局部环，F_x ≅ O_{X,x}^{⊕r}（跨章引理）；又 F 作为 H 的直和项是有限表现，由本章引理知 F 在 x 的某邻域上自由、秩为 r。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a direct summand of a finite locally free module on a ringed space all of whose local rings are local is again finite locally free (author lemma at source lines 2392-2397, label lemma-direct-summand-of-locally-free-is-locally-free). The proof (source lines 2399-2411) trivialises the ambient module at a point, uses that over a local ring a direct summand of a finite free module is finite free, and then applies the criterion for a finitely presented module with free stalk to obtain freeness of the same rank on a neighbourhood (proof lines 2400-2410). The reduction to the stalk together with the localisation criterion is the content. H2.
